dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Whoa, our Archon really is amazing! And super brave, too. She even went toe to toe with Lord Xbalanque!

dialogues.speaker: Kinich
dialogues.text: Don't be so modest. You'd have done the same.

dialogues.speaker: Ajaw
dialogues.text: Hah, like any of us wouldn't! I'd have jumped at the chance! What about you?

dialogues.speaker: Kachina
dialogues.text: I... I wouldn't dare!

dialogues.speaker: Kinich
dialogues.text: Fighting is in a warrior's nature. If the opportunity was presented to you, I'm sure your instincts would make that choice for you.

dialogues.speaker: Citlali
dialogues.text: *sigh* I swear, you're all just brimming with energy over here... This is Lord Xbalanque we're talking about. Our greatest ancestor! Are you really that into sparring with your elders?

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Granny Citlali! Let's spar sometime, too!

dialogues.speaker: Citlali
dialogues.text: No, no, we're absolutely not doing that.

dialogues.speaker: Mausau
dialogues.text: Say, what kind of vegetable do you think I'll become? A red one, or... a green one?

dialogues.speaker: Ororon
dialogues.text: You? I have a feeling... that you might turn into an onion.

dialogues.speaker: Mausau
dialogues.text: An onion?

dialogues.speaker: Ororon
dialogues.text: Someone who looks ordinary, but who can make anyone who attacks you break down and weep.

dialogues.speaker: Mausau
dialogues.text: Really? That sounds super strong...

dialogues.speaker: Iansan
dialogues.text: What are those two even talking about...

dialogues.speaker: Ororon
dialogues.text: Onions are super powerful. One of my friends happened to be cutting onions when I came over to his house. He began to cry, and the Saurians also began to cry, and eventually, nearly every living creature in the room was crying.

dialogues.speaker: Iansan
dialogues.text: What about you? Did you cry too?

dialogues.speaker: Ororon
dialogues.text: I was also in the room, but I shielded my eyes with my cloak just in time. Cacucu and Ifa couldn't see my face, so they thought I cried too.

dialogues.speaker: Mausau
dialogues.text: I'd like to become an onion-man, and make people cry too!

dialogues.speaker: Ororon
dialogues.text: Sure, no problem.

dialogues.speaker: Iansan
dialogues.text: I really want to interrupt you, but I have no clue what to say to derail this line of conversation...

dialogues.speaker: Ororon
dialogues.text: Well, Iansan, you're a tiny... mushroom. Yes.

dialogues.speaker: Iansan
dialogues.text: No one asked you!

dialogues.speaker: Iansan
dialogues.text: Although... mushrooms are pretty resilient, I guess... Okay, I approve.

dialogues.speaker: Mausau
dialogues.text: Then you must be full of life too, right, Miss?

dialogues.speaker: Ororon
dialogues.text: Yes she is.

dialogues.speaker: Iansan
dialogues.text: Yeah... Sure, why not?
